✨ Text-Grab | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: Extracting and copying text from any visible source on Windows, especially from images or areas where text cannot be selected directly.
✨ Key Features: • OCR text extraction from screen regions, images, and PDFs • On-device processing for privacy and no internet dependency • Multiple capture modes (Full-Screen, Region, Window, File) • Background process with global hotkeys
📖 Summary: Text Grab is a Windows application that uses Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to extract text from images, PDFs, and screen regions. It offers multiple capture modes, on-device processing for privacy, and integration with the Windows environment for quick text copying and editing.
